title: UWell Caliburn G3 Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold as 4 pack.
The UWell Caliburn G3 Replacement Pod has a 2ml e-liquid capacity with an integrated coil. The UWell Caliburn G3 Replacement Pod features a top fill design, meaning you simply push the drip tip off the pod with your thumb. The UWell Caliburn G3 Replacement Pod is available in 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.9ohm and 1.2ohm resistances.
2ml E-liquid Capacity
Available in 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.9ohm and 1.2ohm
